name: BADM 3702
title: Risk, Trust, and Modern Security
description: (Also offered as OPIM 3702.) This course explores systems of trust and the technologies used to support them.  Students will take an interdisciplinary look at the assessment of risk and explore modern methods used to cover various types of risks.
requirement_description: OPIM 3207 or BADM 3207; open only to non-business majors of junior or higher status.
